gloss: client; person who makes a request

definitions.gloss: client; person who makes a request or commission
definitions.explanation: A person who hires or requests services from a professional such as a lawyer, detective, or consultant. More formal than simply saying 'customer.'

examples.japanese: {依頼人|いらいにん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{面談|めんだん}→面談：08177_mendan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{弁護士|べんごし}→弁護士：03150_bengoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{依頼人|いらいにん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{利益|りえき}→利益：03673_rieki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧⟦{義務|ぎむ}→義務：02647_gimu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: A lawyer has a duty to protect the interests of their client.

examples.japanese: ⟦{探偵|たんてい}→探偵：07033_tantei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{依頼人|いらいにん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{報告|ほうこく}→報告：03618_houkoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}められた→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: The detective was asked by the client for an investigation report.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{依頼|いらい}→依頼：02594_irai⟧ (request, commission) + ⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧ (person). Refers to someone who has formally requested professional services.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {依頼人|いらいにん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{面談|めんだん}→面談：08177_mendan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to meet with the client
- {依頼人|いらいにん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{利益|りえき}→利益：03673_rieki⟧: the client's interests
- {依頼人|いらいにん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{秘密|ひみつ}→秘密：02504_himitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧: to protect the client's confidentiality

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{顧客|こきゃく}→顧客：08632_kokyaku⟧: customer, client (business context, broader)
- ⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧: customer, guest (general, everyday)
- ⟦クライアント→クライアント：04876_kuraianto⟧: client (loanword, common in business and IT)

USAGE:
Used mainly in legal (⟦{弁護士|べんごし}→弁護士：03150_bengoshi⟧), detective (⟦{探偵|たんてい}→探偵：07033_tantei⟧), and professional service contexts. Implies a formal relationship where someone has commissioned specific services. Common in legal dramas and crime fiction.
